descriptionChirho: To dwell or live in a place, including finite verbal uses (dwelt/dwell) and substantival participle uses (dwellers/inhabitants); all clusters share uniform translation evidence across languages: eng dwell/dwelt/dwellers-of, spa morar/habitar/habitantes, hin रहना/बसना/निवासी, arb سكن/ساكني, kor 거하다, swa kuishi/kukaa — differences are purely grammatical (ketiv/qere, inflection, construct state, conjunction prefix) not semantic.
